notes.title: August 12, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Changes:

Naga's fusion formula has been changed to a Cobra Kite and a monster from the Mystic group


Reasoning:
Turns out I set the same breeding formula (Drake x Mermaid) for both Leviathan and Naga without realizing it until now. Since Leviathan was defined first, it was taking precedence, which meant Naga was not actually able to be fused. This fixes that.

notes.title: January 29, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Fixed a rare softlock that could occur during the enemy's movement phase.

notes.title: January 21, 2023 update notes

notes.title: January 18, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Difficulty can now be selected from Easy, Normal, and Hard when starting a new game. Existing saves should load as if Easy was chosen since that's what the previous only difficulty best fits, and you should be able to continue playing.
Fixed monsters that received multiple level-ups' worth of experience leveling up more times than they should have.
Fixed a timing issue that caused enemies to occasionally target themselves with attacks for no apparent reason.
Level and generation are now shown on the party list buttons.
Monsters can now be released from your party should you wish to abandon them to fend for themselves all alone in the wilderness. The details screen has a "Release" button that will tell them you don't want them anymore.
Accelerate's description was updated to clarify its mechanics.
Wishing Seed now uses Fly movement instead of Walk.


Please report any bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can be fixed.

notes.title: January 13, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Increased text and image size of dialog window on larger screens.

notes.title: January 12, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Today brings yet more usability improvements. It also finishes off my list of reported issues, so unless something else pops up this is likely the last of the series of launch patches. There may be more updates in the future, but not with the same frequency as this past week.


When a monster learns too many abilities, you now select all of the abilities to forget at once.
Tile highlighting visibility in battle has been improved.
If you revisit a completed stage, the world map will now start focused on that stage to better facilitate repeat battles when looking for a specific monster or grinding experience.
Added option to speed up character movement.
Added option to skip dead characters' turns.
Improved spacing around panel borders.
Fixed enemies occasionally attacking themselves.
Fixed odd visuals caused by rotating the camera during an ability animation.


Please report any bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can be fixed.

notes.title: January 11, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Today's patch brings yet more usability improvements, one fix, and a slight balance tweak.


Party members can now be reordered from the Party screen.
Updated Fusion help text to indicate how to view details when selecting a monster, and made this function easier to use with a mouse and keyboard.
Fixed getting double credit for victory in certain circumstances.
Damage that gets absorbed now ignores defense, so the healing won't be mitigated.
Added option to make the AI take its turns faster. This does not effect what it chooses to do.


Please report any bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can be fixed.

notes.title: January 10, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Today brings more usability improvements.


Added Full-screen and Resolution settings to Options.
Added Music and Sound Effect Volume sliders to Options.
The fusion screen will now keep focus on the Flux button when you have selected both monsters, to better facilitate trying out lots of combinations.
Added text to in-battle details indicating whether an enemy is recruitable.
Text lines have been added to the experience/recruit screen to clarify when a monster was not recruited.
Ability details now lists the monster's attack stat next to the scaling factor.
Combined battle popups now pull their hit-sound from the first (if any) damage effect on the ability.
The boss-variant Prismwings in the story battle for stage 9 no longer know Rain Slash.
A fused Watermelon's max level now increases by 20 per +, bringing it up to match the other three Elemelons.


Please report any other bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can also be fixed.

notes.title: January 9, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Here are some more bugfixes and usability improvements.


Fixed softlock during character placement if the previous battle ended under certain conditions.
Fixed softlock caused by the AI being able to move but not having anywhere to move to.
Fixed softlock caused by map-wide abilities under certain conditions.
Fixed story scenes failing to show in certain circumstances (they can be reviewed if missed).
Fixed on-screen buttons getting stuck during unit placement while using a mouse.
The forfeit confirmation no longer gets stuck in a loop when opened while viewing stats during battle.
Selected buttons are now slightly darker to be more noticeable.
Added "Continue" button to loot panel when a monster was not recruited so that what to do then is clearer.
Added "Menu" button to world map, and an option to hide it.
Added text on the experience/recruit screen to indicate when a monster is already max level
Bosses that appear as recruitable later now reveal their bestiary entries when fought the first time.
Added ability count (including max) to "Abilities" button in character details.
When viewing character details, unlearned abilities are now ordered by level learned.



Please report any other bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can also be fixed.

notes.title: January 8, 2023 update #2 notes
notes.content:
Let's round out the weekend with one more small patch that mouse users will love:


Scrollable lists of buttons will no longer auto-scroll when mousing over the buttons, causing the list to jump around. They still auto-scroll when using a keyboard or controller to navigate the list to ensure the selected button is always visible.


Please report any other bugs or issues you encounter on the forum so that they can also be fixed.

notes.title: January 8, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
Today brings more bug fixes and usability improvements:


Fixed soft-locking issues related to clicking around the map during enemy turns.
Fixed not being able to close the help text for saving and loading files with a controller.
Added help text for the "Forget Abilities" state.
Added checkbox to hide the "wait without acting" dialog from the dialog itself. This can still be toggled from the Options menu.
Achievements now update when saving the game instead of just when loading it.


Thank you for your patience as these launch bugs are squashed! If you encounter any more, please post about them on the forum so they can be fixed as well.

notes.title: January 7, 2023 update #2 notes
notes.content:
This second patch of the day includes some more substantial bug fixes:


Fixed the fusion screen breaking after completing a fusion,
Fixed experience distribution breaking on monsters that had been fused after the most recent save.
Fixed an issue with Lingering abilities causing the game to become stuck.
The cancel button on the confirmation dialog for deleting an ability works now.
Reworded some labels in the Options menu to better fit the space.
Cleaned up the artwork for Doctorpus.

notes.title: January 7, 2023 update notes
notes.content:
This first patch brings some small usability improvements.


A Continue button was added to the title screen that will load the most recent save
The Continue and Load Game buttons will be hidden if there are no save files to load
Instructions have been clarified for placing monsters at battle start
Character selection will skip straight to placement if there is only one monster in your party

notes.title: Pedigree Tactics beta is now open to all
notes.content:
Pedigree Tactics will be freely available in full to playtest for a limited time. Just click "Join the playtest" on the store page and enjoy! I got some excellent feedback from the last one, so please keep it coming. Let me know what you think and what could be improved.

Here are the changes from the previous playtest:

 The UI has been redone to give the appearance that it's on ripped out scraps of white paper, instead of old faded square paper
 Control reminders can be shown during battle (enabled by default)
 Monsters' details can be viewed from the fusion screen without having to back out
 Monsters' details can be viewed during the unit placement phase of battle instead of only after the battle has begun
 Your active monsters' details  can be viewed from battle menus without having to "Look" at the map first
 The missing background in level 5 has been added
 Font readability has been improved
